summary.text: J. Gary Pretlow is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly who has represented what is now District 89 since 1992 and is seeking re-election in 2026.
He was appointed chairman of the Ways and Means Committee in 2025 and previously chaired the Racing and Wagering Committee for 19 years.

paragraphs.text: J. Gary Pretlow began his career as manager of accounting at Bloomingdale's and assistant controller at The Limited.
In 1985 he co-founded Moncur-Pretlow & Company, a financial planning and management consulting firm, and was elected to the Mount Vernon City Council that year.
On the council he chaired the Finance and Planning Committee and the Capital Projects Board, and he also served as a commissioner of the Mount Vernon Housing Authority.
Pretlow was elected to the Assembly in 1992 from the district then numbered the 84th, which is now the 89th and includes the City of Mount Vernon and part of Yonkers.
His first chairmanship was the Racing and Wagering Committee, which he led for 19 years.

He sponsored Cynthia's Law, which classifies reckless assault of a child as a Class D felony, and Ava's Law, which directs the State Department of Health to provide information on resources for people who have suffered a pregnancy or infant loss.
In 2025 he became chairman of the Ways and Means Committee, and he is a longtime member of the Rules and Assembly Steering committees.
Pretlow lives in Mount Vernon with his wife, Donna.
